description: Reads this environment's AI tool calls, newest first — the tool, who called it (a person's id, never for a relay or a key), the cost, the status, and (where the tool records it) the prompt and answer, wrapped as a customer's or the founder's own words. Filter by person. Up to 50 (before = the last page's cursor). This is what a founder may call checking what an AI tool has been doing.
name: ai_calls_read
title: Read AI tool calls
